sources.title: Heretic: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models
sources.snippet: Using Heretic does not require an understanding of transformer internals. In fact, anyone who knows how to run a command-line program can use Heretic to decensor language models. Heretic supports most dense models, including many multimodal models, several different MoE architectures, and even some hybrid models like Qwen3.5.

sources.title: Qwen3.6 无审查模型翻车：下载量 550 万的爆款被扒开源换皮 | AiTimes 智能时代
sources.snippet: 事件概述 Hugging Face 上下载量超过 550 万 的 Qwen3.6 无审查模型系列（作者 HauhauCS），被 LocalLLaMA 社区扒出：核心工具来自开源项目 Heretic，属于开源换皮；而其宣传的"零损失"也未能站住。 1. 翻车经过 HauhauCS 的模型卡宣传： 0/465 拒绝 Zero capability loss 私有方法
